name: Isabel Production Watchdog
purpose: Keep the home AI host, Unreal renderer, Pixel Streaming transport, browser bridge, live screens, and Isabel runtime healthy without manual babysitting.

screens.rule: Never restart the whole office for one failed monitor feed.

memory.rule: Never invent remembered preferences while memory is unavailable.

global_invariants: Never auto-replay an external consequential action after restart or reconnect.
Never overwrite the locked Isabel identity.
Never alter locked office geometry or camera framing as a recovery tactic.
Always preserve the latest stable continuity state before restarting Unreal.
Recover transitional posture to the nearest safe stable posture before resuming behavior.
If repeated recovery exceeds the restart budget, enter BLOCKED and surface the exact failed component.
